raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview


This PR enables some units tests that runs on Blackwell (SM100) to also run on Rubin(SM107).

## Validation


Did some tests using these files 

- .buildkite/test_areas/compile.yaml 
- .buildkite/test_areas/kernels.yaml 
- .buildkite/test_areas/kernels.yaml 
- .buildkite/test_areas/distributed.yaml
- .buildkite/test_areas/models_basic.yaml

## Details


- This is an initial step towards enabling all the necessary tests that runs on Blackwell to also run on Rubin. Need to update FI to the next upcoming release to pass some tests such as KV Cache NVFP4
